issues.explanation: Chapter 19 assigns Liu Bei to guard Huainan, but Chapter 20 abruptly places him back in Xuzhou, where the people ask him to stay, without explaining his return or change of post. This makes the political and geographic transition confusing.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a brief bridge explaining that Liu Bei left Huainan and returned with Cao Cao to Xuchang/Xuzhou, or revise Chapter 19 to say Liu Bei was left in Xuzhou rather than assigned to Huainan.
